properties.site-address: Blackhorse Road Car Park (TfL Forest Road Carpark - Part of BHL site 1)
properties.notes: Redevelopment of the existing car park site involving demolition of existing structures and the construction of a building ranging from 5 to 21 storeys in height comprising 350 residential units (Use ClassC3) approximately 1,650 sqm of flexible commercial floor space (Use Class A1 to A4, B1, D1 or D2), community cycle hub, ancillary refuse stores, servicing, parking, landscaping and associated public realm works.
